note: Art direction for the Starter Box (SB1): the shared style, each family's background, and one subject per illustration. tools/generate_art.py reads it.
style: Cute collectible trading card game illustration in a polished chibi storybook cartoon style: bold clean outlines, soft cel shading, vibrant saturated colours, big expressive sparkly eyes, warm and friendly mood. One clear main subject, centred and fully in frame, with a softly painted background scene. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

families.Citrus: Background: a sunny Mediterranean citrus grove with lemon and orange trees, warm yellow and orange light.

heroStyle: A cute collectible mascot character drawn as a soft plush toy, in a simple flat kawaii sticker style: one chunky rounded cat with bold clean black outlines, completely flat colours, no gradients and almost no shading. The body is plain and simple with stubby little legs, small paws and a short tail. The face is minimal and sewn-on looking: two tiny black dot eyes set wide apart, a small soft smile, two round pink blush ovals on the cheeks, three short black stripes on the forehead, and three long straight black whiskers on each side of the face. The cat wears a soft fruit-shaped hood over its head and back, with its two little cat ears poking out through the hood. One single character, centred, facing the viewer, whole body in frame with room around it, on a plain soft pastel background with a few simple doodled sparkles. Toy-like and huggable, never realistic, no fur texture, no photo realism, no 3D render. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.
